Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six

Strand: THE FARM – ANIMAL SAFETY AND CARE Suggested Vocabulary veterinary, poisonous, cr
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Fluency

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 8.2.1 Fluency, part of THE FARM – ANIMAL SAFETY AND CARE Suggested Vocabulary veterinary, poisonous, cr in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you improve your reading speed? 2. What are some of the feelings you show when reading a story or poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 8.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to read fluently builds confidence as the learner reads a text on animal safety, while

observing punctuation marks.

 Digital Literacy: The learner’s ability to manipulate devices is enhanced as they access a video and practise various aspects

of reading fluency.

Values:
Social Justice is developed in the learner as they share resources equitably with peers while watching a video on reading

fluency.

Unity is displayed as the learner displays team spirit while reciting the choral verse with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

70

Animal welfare: The learner develops a sense of responsibility and care for animals as they interact with information on

animal safety while reading a text.

Link to other Subjects

Reading fluency is critical when reading and appreciating reading texts in Kiswahili.
